2608.12190.title: Machine Learning-Based Cyber Defense for Cloud Infrastructure: An Adaptive Deep Q-Network Architecture for Intelligent Intrusion Detection and Automated Threat Mitigation
2608.12190.paper_summary: With the increasing complexity of cyber assaults in cloud environments, adaptable security solutions are needed that can support real-time detection and autonomous response. In this paper, we propose a reinforcement learning-based dynamic cyber defense framework. We deploy a Deep Q-Network (DQN) to train effective defensive strategies to counteract the evolving cyberattacks. We leverage the CICIDS2017 dataset for model creation and the UNSW-NB15 dataset for external validation, involving preprocessing of data, feature engineering, and adaptive policy learning. We compare the proposed DQN with decision tree, support vector machine, random forest, XGBoost, and multilayer perceptron models. The proposed DQN achieves an accuracy of 99.72%, a precision of 99.68%, a recall of 99.65%, an F1-score of 99.66%, and an ROC-AUC of 0.999, while the false positive rate is 0.31%, the false negative rate is 0.35%, and the detection latency is 15 ms. The framework achieved 99.54% attack mitigation rate, demonstrating strong adaptive and real-time defensive capabilities. These results demonstrate the potential of reinforcement learning as a powerful and scalable approach for autonomous cybersecurity in modern cloud environments.
2608.12190.paper_summary_zh: 隨著雲端環境中網路攻擊的複雜性日益增加，需要能夠支持實時檢測和自主響應的適應性安全解決方案。本文提出了一種基於增強學習的動態網路防禦框架。我們部署了一個深度Q網路（DQN）來訓練有效的防禦策略，以對抗不斷演變的網路攻擊。我們利用CICIDS2017數據集進行模型創建，並使用UNSW-NB15數據集進行外部驗證，涉及數據預處理、特徵工程和自適應策略學習。我們將所提出的DQN與決策樹、支持向量機、隨機森林、XGBoost和多層感知器模型進行比較。所提出的DQN達到了99.72%的準確率，99.68%的精確率，99.65%的召回率，99.66%的F1分數，以及0.999的ROC-AUC，而假陽性率為0.31%，假陰性率為0.35%，檢測延遲為15毫秒。該框架實現了99.54%的攻擊緩解率，展示了強大的適應性和實時防禦能力。這些結果顯示了增強學習作為一種強大且可擴展的自主網路安全方法在現代雲端環境中的潛力。
